resources.note: INVENTED placeholders shared by every case and by EXAMPLE_INVENTORY.json. They are not the owner-reviewed company resources, which are private.
resources.context:company_name: 示例機電股份有限公司

job_inputs.context:project_name: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

assumptions: Unless a case says otherwise, the line lies inside the quoted range (R49) of the detailed bill sheet, and every row carries L, M and N from the job inputs (R48) with K, O, P, G and H null.
Input cells are the line's own cells: description (a list when the item has continuation rows), unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, remarks. A missing key means an empty cell.
Expected values list only the fields the case is about; "row": false means the line gives no 未填 row and its cells take the stated census role.

expected.N: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

cases.reason: Every row copies L, M and N exactly from the job inputs and cites only those context refs (route v4 carries them as selection evidence). K, O and P stay null.

expected.N: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

cases.reason: M and N come only from the job inputs. A letterhead, addressee line, contract-party label or signature never establishes K, M or N; inferring M or N from them is a critical error (R6).

lines.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: The quoted range ends at the row whose unit-price or amount column holds 合計 or 總計. Lines after it give no row even when priced.

lines.description: 產品，計時器，限時繼電器，AC220V

cases.reason: A 合計 written in the description column is a block total, not the end of the range; the range runs on to the 總計 in the unit-price column.

sheets.總表: summary of section totals per site (甲站 12000, 乙站 8000)
sheets.詳細表: detailed bill with the sender's prices: 一、甲站 (材料, 工資 subsections), 二、乙站 (材料, 工資 subsections), then 合計 in the amount column

expected.rows: every priced, not-estimated or zero-state line of both sites and both subsections on 詳細表

cases.reason: Rows come only from the detailed bill sheet that carries the sender's prices. Repeated site sections and goods/labour subsections inside the range are all in it; summary sheets never yield rows.

input.description: 產品，控制開關，選擇開關，30mm

cases.reason: A not-estimated line (amount cell holds the literal 不含估價) is a row. I and J both hold the status text, citing the amount cell; Q is null.

input.description: 產品，計時器，限時繼電器，AC220V

cases.reason: A zero-state line (a cached 0 amount with no unit price) is a row with I, J and Q null.

expected.census: excluded_supply (all cells, including the item number)
expected.reason_begins: no enclosure and no estimate: not in the quoted supply (R45)

cases.reason: A line with no price and no status gives no row. Its reason names the empty price cells.
The sender's unnumbered fee lines before the end row (freight, drawing, design or management fee) are rows. A fee line has C null and the description in D.

input.remarks: 業主供料，本項暫不使用

cases.reason: Supply and separate-contract markers do not decide inclusion and are never copied into a field; a remark saying a line is not used does not remove it. Both stay in raw text.

census.lines 3, 3.1, 3.2: excluded_supply; the reason names the marker 業主供料 and the provisional O10 omission (R50 states no census role for O10 omissions; excluded_supply is the role for lines that are not 未填 rows)

cases.reason: Provisionally (O10), a panel line marked owner-supplied is omitted together with its contents when no line inside it has a price inside the quoted range. This also omits the not-estimated line 3.1, which R50 alone would make a row.

rows: line 3.1: C XNB, D 3P 50AT, I 不含估價, J 不含估價, Q null
line 3.2: C XPL, D AC220V, Q 150

census.line 3: excluded_supply under the R50 row tests (no price and no status; the marker does not decide inclusion)

cases.reason: A line inside the panel has a price inside the range, so the O10 omission does not apply and each line follows the R50 row tests: the not-estimated and priced lines are rows; the panel line itself has no price and no status. (The O10 decision record reads "the panel group stays and its lines are rows"; R50 as written does not make the unpriced panel line a row. This is recorded as an open question.)
Never split or merge lines and never add rows: a line naming two devices is one row. Single-segment equipment noun with no glossary entry: C is the noun, D null (R52).

lines.description: 盤體組立配線 單價分析
lines.position: analysis block inside the quoted range, before the end row

census.line 6 (parent): section, reason "parent of analysis components listed as rows (R51)"

cases.reason: The bill line has no price and no status and its analysis block lies in range, so the components are the rows instead of the parent, in analysis order, written as demand items. They follow R52-R57: their own unit, quantity and unit price; I = J = 不含估價 when not estimated.

input.bill_lines: every bill line has no unit price and no amount (a contract without line prices); each has an analysis block on the analysis sheet

expected.rows: the components of every block, block by block in analysis order, as demand items

census.bill lines: section, reason "parent of analysis components listed as rows (R51)"

cases.reason: When every bill line is unpriced, rows come from the analysis sheet instead (R49, R51).

lines.description: 盤體組立配線 單價分析 (components 組立工資, 配線材料; block 計 5000)

expected.components: analysis_component items with component links (R21, R25), not rows

cases.reason: When the parent line is priced or not estimated, its components are never rows; they stay analysis_component items (or analysis_unlinked cells under R46).

input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: Q is the line's unit price as a number, cited from its unit-price cell, never the amount.

expected.J: 示例機電股份有限公司

cases.reason: A priced line supplying an enclosure is one row. A is the enclosure noun from the line, B is built from the stated dimensions, C is the glossary's generic enclosure word, D is what remains after the prefix, the category word, the enclosure noun and the dimensions, I is null and J is the company name.

rows.J: 示例機電股份有限公司

cases.reason: The enclosure line names only a generic box, so A comes from its section heading; no dimensions are stated, so B is null. No other row carries A or B, and no groups are formed for the section.
E and F are copied verbatim from the line's own unit and quantity cells, even when they look implausible. G and H stay null.
